project_type: Flutter app (BrainBuddies) — a comic-styled hub of 6 educational mini-games for kids 6-9. Web is the primary play-test/verify target.
build_system: Flutter. Flutter lives at %USERPROFILE%\flutter. Shell is PowerShell: use ';' not '&&', and $env:VAR not %VAR%. Always invoke flutter explicitly as & "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" <cmd>. The project path contains non-ASCII Hebrew characters (expected).
test_framework: flutter_test (widget + unit tests under test/). Existing: test/widget_test.dart.
verification_instructions: Run build web then test from the worktree root. Build success is confirmed by the presence of 'Built build\web' in output; a trailing 'Exit Code: 1' from Select-String filtering (no matches after the Built line) is NOT a failure. DO NOT run `flutter analyze` — it crashes on the non-ASCII (Hebrew) path. Widget tests set a 430x900 phone surface via tester.view.physicalSize; new widget tests must do the same.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in from build; build\web is a build artifact and is not committed.
environment_constraints: flutter analyze CRASHES on this project (non-ASCII path) — never rely on it. The app is capped to a 430px phone frame; never size widgets from MediaQuery.of(context).size.width — use LayoutBuilder + constraints.maxWidth. Web audio unlocks on first user gesture (expected). This is a LIVE kids' app — keep everything friendly/non-scary.
contribution_requirements: Shared state (coins, avatar, achievements, streak, pet, missions) lives ONLY in lib/core/services/player_profile.dart. Per-game progress lives in each game's own ChangeNotifier under lib/games/<game>/services/*_state.dart. Games report round end via profile.onRoundFinished(correct, coinsEarned, threeStars, bossBeaten); do NOT re-implement streak/pet/missions per game. Reusable UI goes in lib/core/widgets. Import depth game->core is ../../../core/... Extension methods need their defining file imported (common 'getter isn't defined' build failure). Prefer const constructors and the comic style (AppTheme.comicBorder, AppTheme.comicShadow, AppTheme.success/danger/ink).
key_patterns: Each game screen computes answered-tile color via a helper: white when unanswered, AppTheme.success for the correct index, AppTheme.danger for the chosen-wrong index. Tiles are either ComicButton (text choices; no overlay slot) or a GestureDetector->Container (visual tiles: shapes, analog clocks, coin piles). Choice grids live inside LayoutBuilder with tileWidth = (constraints.maxWidth - 14)/2. PlayerProfile.onRoundFinished and recordGamePlayed are the single hub-wide hooks. The money question generator picks types from difficulty d and uses a seen-set + ~25-try dedupe loop (generateRound/generateOne), with _distinctAmounts producing distinct positive cent options.

lib/games/clock_hero/screens/clock_game_screen.dart — _bgFor helper, _TextChoices ComicButton tiles AND clockChoices Container tiles

directory_structure: lib/app (hub shell: game_hub_screen, shop/achievements/missions/pet/avatar), lib/core/{models,services,theme,widgets} (shared), lib/games/<game>/{models,services,screens,widgets} for number_quest/shape_safari/word_wizard/clock_hero/money_math/memory_match. Tests in test/.
